english.text: She said to her, "All that you say, I will do." She went down to the threshing floor, and did everything that her mother-in-law told her. At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet. He said, "Who are you?"

text: 佢同佢講：「你所有講嘅嘢，我都會做。」佢落去打麥場，做咗佢婆婆同佢講嘅所有嘢。當波阿斯食完飲完之後，佢就喺嗰堆穀物嘅尾端躺低。佢輕輕噉走嚟，揭開佢對腳，然後趴低。半夜，個男人驚咗，轉身見到有個女人趴喺佢腳邊，佢話：「你係邊個？」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Nothing is original. Steal from anywhere that resonates with inspiration or fuels your imagination. Devour old films, new films, music, books, paintings, photographs, poems, dreams, random conversations, architecture, bridges, street signs, trees, clouds, bodies of water, light and shadows. Select only things to steal from that speak directly to your soul. If you do this, your work, and theft, will be authentic. Authenticity is invaluable, originality is non-existent. And don't bother concealing your thievery—celebrate it if you feel like it. In any case, remember what Jean-Luc Godard said: "It's not where you take things from—it's where you take them to."

jyutping: mou5 je5 hai6 jyun4 cong3 ge3。hai2 jam6 ho4 tung4 ling4 gam2 jau5 gung6 ming4 waak6 ze2 gik1 faat3 soeng2 zoeng6 lik6 ge3 dei6 fong1 tau1 je5。tan1 sai6 gau6 din6 jing2、san1 din6 jing2、jam1 ngok6、syu1 zik6、waa2 zok3、soeng3 pin2、si1 go1、mung6 soeng2、ceoi4 gei1 deoi3 waa6、gin3 zuk1、kiu4 loeng4、gaai1 paai4、syu6 muk6、wan4、seoi2 wik6、gwong1 jing2。zing6 hai6 gaan2 di1 jiu3 tau1 ge3 je5，zik6 zip3 tung4 nei5 ge3 ling4 wan4 gong2 je5。jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gam3 zou6，nei5 ge3 gung1 zok3 tung4 dou6 sit3，dou1 wui6 hai6 zing3 zung1 ge3。zan1 sat6 sing3 hai6 mou4 gaa3 zi1 zik6，jyun4 cong3 sing3 hai6 m4 cyun4 zoi6 ge3。tung4 maai4 m4 hou2 faan4 zyu6 jan2 mun4 nei5 ge3 tau1 sit3 hang4 wai4 —— jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 ge3 waa2，zau6 hing3 zuk1 laa1。mou4 leon6 dim2 joeng2，gei3 zyu6 - lou4 hak1 · gwo1 daat6 gong2 gwo3 ge3 syut3 waa6：「m4 hai6 nei5 lo2 je5 ge3 dei6 fong1，ji4 hai6 nei5 daai2 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 ge3 dei6 fong1。」
text: 冇嘢係原創嘅。喺任何同靈感有共鳴或者激發想像力嘅地方偷嘢。吞噬舊電影、新電影、音樂、書籍、畫作、相片、詩歌、夢想、隨機對話、建築、橋樑、街牌、樹木、雲、水域、光影。淨係揀啲要偷嘅嘢，直接同你嘅靈魂講嘢。如果你咁做，你嘅工作同盜竊，都會係正宗嘅。真實性係無價之值，原創性係唔存在嘅。同埋唔好煩住隱瞞你嘅偷竊行為 —— 如果你想嘅話，就慶祝啦。無論點樣，記住 - 盧克 · 戈達講過嘅說話：「唔係你攞嘢嘅地方，而係你帶佢哋去嘅地方。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: This band have a song in an EP from a year ago about the loss of strength and giving up, and this year they managed without obstacles to represent their country in the biggest music competition in the world and gained thousands of fans from many countries. The fact that my friend is a big fan of theirs gives me hope that he'll still continue with creative work in one way or another, even if his focus would be completely different from what it used to be before. I don't have any expectations, but I'm ready to support him as soon as he comes back to what he used to love.

text: 呢隊樂隊喺一年前嘅一張 EP 入面有首歌係講緊失去力量同放棄，而今年佢哋冇任何障礙噉代表佢哋嘅國家參加世界上最大嘅音樂比賽，並且贏得咗嚟自好多國家嘅成千上萬粉絲，呢個事實令我希望佢仍然會以一種或另一種方式繼續創作，即使佢嘅重點會同我以前嘅期望完全唔同返返去佢以前鍾意嘅嘢。
